description: US federal and state statutory law MCP server. 529K sections across 50 states, the US Code, and Code of Federal Regulations. 11 tools: fulltext search, citation graph traversal, cross-reference navigation, risk surface analysis, doctrinal lineage. Free tier — no API key needed.
